posts.title: Currency in Fantasy
posts.description: Currency is one of those worldbuilding elements that can swallow weeks of writing time. Why I kept the Marchlands money simple, and how a single short story did the work a whole chapter would have needed.

posts.title: The Art of Dread
posts.description: Dread is not fear and it is not horror. It is the long corridor before the door. What dread asks of a writer, and how three of my own stories use it differently.

posts.title: Grimdark vs Dark Fantasy: What's the Difference?
posts.description: Grimdark and dark fantasy share a surface but do fundamentally different work. What each tradition does with darkness, and why the distinction matters.
